grading_basis: Strict reading of each assertion's text, per the grading paragraph of docs/BUILD.md section 5 (quoted in the grading brief) and the three readings fixed on 2026-10-12: cited lines graded by the statement reading with the physical-line reading recorded; 'confirmed finding' = a VERIFIED REAL verdict; hygiene counts files git would track (tracked, or untracked and not ignored), ignored build output recorded only. PASS or FAIL only; an ambiguity not settled by those readings is graded by the stricter reading and the other reading is recorded in grade_other_reading. Sources: the run's outputs/ (paths below are relative to the run directory), the run's working copy (read-only git with --no-optional-locks), the run's transcript (parsed with a python3 -B script; jsonl:n = line n, UTC timestamps) and the reference checkout at its commit (git show <commit>:<path> | nl). R:n = line n of outputs/docs-audits/<new report>. No test, skill script with --run, or tools/repro_f2.py was executed by the grader.
